title: Dual adjustable bench supply
goal: A reader must be able to identify the centre-tapped AC input, rectifier, and independent adjustable positive and negative output rails.

rubric.must: A transformer labelled 230 V to 2 × 18 V AC shows a centre-tap connection to 0 V.
A labelled bridge rectifier is visibly placed between the transformer secondary and the DC supply branches.
The output rails are visibly labelled VPOS and VNEG and are not presented as the same polarity.
An LM317 serves the positive branch and an LM337 serves the negative branch.
Each regulator branch includes a labelled 240 Ω resistor and a labelled 5 kΩ adjustment potentiometer.
Both branches visibly include labelled input reservoir capacitors and output capacitors.
Four labelled 1N4007 protection diodes are visible around the regulator branches.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Centre-tapped secondary with the tap as 0 V, four rectifier diodes drawn flat as two legs (RAW_N to SEC to RAW_P) so both rails are genuinely rectified, LM317 and LM337 each with its 240 ohm resistor and 5k adjust pot, and the four protection diodes across each regulator.
